scope: Creator-Safe matching for the VALORANT lists in js/catalog.js: val-themes (Champions anthems 2021-2026, 6 songs), val-agent-themes (agent-related songs, 3 songs) and val-cs (the 39 songs of the official VALORANT Creator-Safe Playlist, trk118).

creatorSafe.description: VALORANT's official Spotify playlist 'VALORANT Creator-Safe Playlist': 'Welcome to the collection of all VALORANT Music that is 100% owned by Riot Games. It can be used in streams and content creation as long as it follows the "Legal Jibber Jabber" rules at riotgames.com/legal' (40 entries on 2026-10-12).
creatorSafe.method: Read all 40 entries on the official Spotify embed of the playlist (the embed lists up to 100 entries, so this is the whole playlist) and compared titles (case and apostrophes ignored) and artists. Also compared against the 977 rows of the Riot Games Creator-Safe Playlist read for League of Legends (tools/leagueoflegends-soundcloud-albums-tracklist.json creatorSafe.mirror): it lists 36 VALORANT rows, all of whose titles are also in the VALORANT playlist. None of the 9 catalog songs is in either playlist.
